rationale: Status no. The held original of EO 12082 (43 FR 42727, fr-originals text, read in full) suspends five Title 10 provisions and makes three disability-separation conditions effective only for the period September 15, 1978 to September 30, 1979, so those commands ended under the order's own terms on 1979-09-30; sec. 1-103 was a one-time revocation performed on issuance. EO 12239 (21 September 1980, 45 FR 62967, official FR text) then revoked Executive Order No. 12082 in sec. 1-103, which is the formal disposition after the order had expired; it supports the no status whichever end is taken. No extension of the period, no partial survival and no saving clause appear in the held texts; later-source searches found no contrary event.
